title: Support the NetworkManager ipv6 option "addr-gen-mode"
line: The IPv6 page of a connection now has an Address Generation setting, and saving a connection no longer resets a hand-set EUI-64 or Default mode to Stable privacy.
explanation: The connection editor's IPv6 page had no field for ipv6.addr-gen-mode. When saving, it built a fresh IPv6 setting from the visible fields only, so networkmanager-qt's built-in default (stable-privacy) was always written, overwriting eui64 or default set in the .nmconnection file. networkmanager-qt also could not represent the default and default-or-eui64 modes that NetworkManager 1.40 added. networkmanager-qt now has those two enum values, and the IPv6 page has an Address Generation combo box (Default, Default or EUI-64, Stable privacy, EUI-64; the two Default entries only with NetworkManager 1.40+) that loads the saved mode and writes it back.

commits.message:
Ipv6Setting: add the Default and DefaultOrEui64 address generation modes

IPv6AddressGenMode only knew eui64 and stable-privacy, so the "default"
and "default-or-eui64" values that NetworkManager 1.40 added could not
be represented. Add them with the numeric values NetworkManager uses.

BUG: 503773

editor/ipv6: let the user choose the address generation mode

The IPv6 page had no field for ipv6.addr-gen-mode and always saved the
default stable-privacy, wiping eui64 or default set elsewhere. Add an
Address Generation combo box that shows the saved mode and keeps it.

BUG: 503773

From 57dada533d2095d06b9b3e8505b0a2bbe78f9417 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:09:02 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Ipv6Setting: add the Default and DefaultOrEui64 address
 generation modes

IPv6AddressGenMode only knew eui64 and stable-privacy, so the "default"
and "default-or-eui64" values that NetworkManager 1.40 added could not
be represented. Add them with the numeric values NetworkManager uses.

BUG: 503773
---
 src/settings/ipv6setting.h | 4 ++++
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/settings/ipv6setting.h b/src/settings/ipv6setting.h
index 2d32ece..b4cb843 100644
--- a/src/settings/ipv6setting.h
+++ b/src/settings/ipv6setting.h
@@ -117,10 +117,14 @@ public:
      *
      * \value Eui64
      * \value StablePrivacy
+     * \value[since 6.33] DefaultOrEui64 Use the global default, falling back to Eui64. Requires NetworkManager 1.40
+     * \value[since 6.33] Default Use the global default, falling back to StablePrivacy. Requires NetworkManager 1.40
      */
     enum IPv6AddressGenMode {
         Eui64,
         StablePrivacy,
+        DefaultOrEui64,
+        Default,
     };
 
     /*!
--

     if (setting) {

     if (ipv6Setting->privacy() != NetworkManager::Ipv6Setting::Unknown) {
         m_ui->privacyCombo->setCurrentIndex(static_cast<int>(ipv6Setting->privacy()) + 1);
     }
+
+    // addr-gen-mode
+    const int addrGenModeIndex = m_ui->addrGenModeCombo->findData(ipv6Setting->addressGenMode());
+    if (addrGenModeIndex != -1) {
+        m_ui->addrGenModeCombo->setCurrentIndex(addrGenModeIndex);
+    }
 }

         ipv6Setting.setPrivacy(static_cast<NetworkManager::Ipv6Setting::IPv6Privacy>(m_ui->privacyCombo->currentIndex() - 1));
     }
 
+    // addr-gen-mode
+    ipv6Setting.setAddressGenMode(static_cast<NetworkManager::Ipv6Setting::IPv6AddressGenMode>(m_ui->addrGenModeCombo->currentData().toInt()));
+
     return ipv6Setting.toMap();
 }

media.caption: IPv6 page of a wired connection whose profile has addr-gen-mode=eui64: no address generation setting. Renaming the connection and pressing Apply saved addr-gen-mode=1 (stable-privacy).
